purpose: Issue-routing and freshness metadata only; verify current official text.

regimes.title: Privacy Act 1988 Part IIIC
regimes.trigger_prompt: suspected or reasonably believed eligible data breach by a covered entity
regimes.clock_prompt: assessment reasonable and expeditious with all reasonable steps within 30 calendar days after suspicion; notification as soon as practicable after reasonable belief
regimes.watch_note: Reported after the snapshot (24 September 2026 review, not yet confirmed against the Attorney-General's Department): the exposure draft Privacy Amendment (Personal Data Protection) Bill 2026 (31 August 2026) proposes notifying the Commissioner of an eligible data breach within 72 hours after reasonable grounds to believe one has occurred. Proposal only; current law unchanged. Do not apply a 72-hour NDB deadline unless a later Act and its commencement are verified. Source: https://consultations.ag.gov.au/rights-and-protections/privacy-reform/

regimes.title: Security of Critical Infrastructure Act 2018 Part 2B and Application Rules
regimes.trigger_prompt: responsible entity, covered asset and reportable cyber incident
regimes.clock_prompt: significant availability impact as soon as practicable and no later than 12 hours; other actual or likely relevant impact no later than 72 hours; verify oral follow-up clocks
regimes.watch_note: Reported after the snapshot (24 September 2026 review, not yet confirmed against Home Affairs): following the Independent Review of the SOCI Act (delivered 31 January 2026), Home Affairs released a consultation paper on 3 July 2026 proposing 21 measures to streamline and modernise the Act; submissions closed 31 July 2026. Proposals only; current law unchanged. Verify at use whether a Bill or exposure draft has followed. Source: https://www.homeaffairs.gov.au/help-and-support/how-to-engage-us/consultations/proposed-amendments-to-streamline-and-modernise-the-soci-act-2018

regimes.title: Security of Critical Infrastructure (Critical infrastructure risk management program) Rules 2023
regimes.amending_instrument: Security of Critical Infrastructure Legislation Amendment (Enhanced Critical Infrastructure Risk Management Program) Rules 2026 (LIN 26/075, F2026L00701), made 4 June 2026, registered 9 June 2026, commenced 10 June 2026; grace periods of 12 months (s 6A, ss 8A(2), 9A(2)) and 24 months (ss 8A, 8B, 8C, 9A, 10A, 11A) from commencement or from when an asset becomes a critical infrastructure asset; the spent amending instrument was auto-repealed on 8 September 2026 under s 48A of the Legislation Act 2003
regimes.trigger_prompt: responsible entity for an asset within Part 2A and current Rules

regimes.title: Security of Critical Infrastructure (Telecommunications Security and Risk Management Program) Rules 2025
regimes.supersedes: Telecommunications Act 1997 Part 14 TSSR obligations ceased 2025-04-04

regimes.title: Cyber Security Act 2024 Part 3 and Cyber Security (Ransomware Payment Reporting) Rules 2025
regimes.trigger_prompt: covered reporting business entity, cyber incident, demand and payment or knowledge of payment
regimes.clock_prompt: within 72 hours after payment or awareness another entity paid on its behalf; verify current turnover threshold and content rules

regimes.title: Cyber Security Act 2024 Part 2 and Cyber Security (Security Standards for Smart Devices) Rules 2025
regimes.trigger_prompt: manufacturer or supplier of an in-scope consumer-grade connectable product manufactured on or after commencement

regimes.title: Cyber Security Act 2024 Part 5 and Cyber Security (Cyber Incident Review Board) Rules 2025
regimes.status_note: Board active by May 2026; do not label prospective

regimes.title: CPS 234 Information Security
regimes.trigger_prompt: APRA-regulated entity, material information-security incident or material control weakness
regimes.clock_prompt: incident as soon as possible and no later than 72 hours; material control weakness as soon as possible and no later than 10 business days

regimes.title: CPS 230 Operational Risk Management
regimes.clock_prompt: verify 72-hour material operational-risk incident, 24-hour tolerance breach and service-provider clocks; where one APRA notice is accepted apply the earliest timeframe

regimes.title: Telecommunications (Domestic, Family and Sexual Violence Consumer Protections) Industry Standard 2025
regimes.legal_status: delegated legislative instrument or industry standard
regimes.clock_prompt: affected person using agreed safe communications and ACMA within two days after specified unauthorised access or disclosure; verify which commencement phase the notice duty sits in

regimes.title: Competition and Consumer Act 2010 Part IVD and Consumer Data Right Rules
regimes.clock_prompt: NDB extension where applicable plus accredited data recipient ACSC notice as soon as practicable and no later than 30 days; verify current Schedule 2

regimes.title: My Health Records Act 2012 section 75
regimes.clock_prompt: as soon as practicable to the entity-specific recipient or recipients; test Privacy Act section 26WD duplicate-notice interaction

regimes.title: Healthcare Identifiers Act 2010
regimes.trigger_prompt: verify collection, use or disclosure restrictions and route any resulting Privacy Act or My Health Record incident separately; do not invent a standalone general breach-notification scheme

regimes.title: Telecommunications Act 1997 Part 13
regimes.trigger_prompt: use or disclosure of communications, service information, affairs or personal particulars; verify offences, exceptions and record obligations

regimes.title: Telecommunications (Customer Communications for Outages) Industry Standard 2024
regimes.legal_status: delegated legislative instrument or industry standard
regimes.trigger_prompt: significant or major outage, including a cyber-caused outage; keep outage communications distinct from data-breach notice

regimes.title: Cyber Security Act 2024 Part 4
regimes.legal_status: Act establishing voluntary sharing and limited-use rules
regimes.trigger_prompt: voluntary sharing with the National Cyber Security Coordinator; section 44 does not satisfy or affect other reporting duties

regimes.title: ACSC incident assistance and reporting
regimes.legal_status: voluntary report or regulator guidance unless another verified source makes it mandatory
regimes.trigger_prompt: do not label general ACSC reporting mandatory; separately test SOCI, CDR, contract and sector duties

regimes.title: Spam Act 2003
regimes.trigger_prompt: commercial electronic messages, including AI outbound messaging; verify consent, sender identity and unsubscribe, including the current five-business-day rule

regimes.title: Do Not Call Register Act 2006 and applicable telemarketing industry standard
regimes.trigger_prompt: AI outbound calling or telemarketing; verify registered number, consent or exemption, checking period, contract and calling-standard requirements

regimes.title: Corporations Act 2001 sections 912D and 912DAA
regimes.trigger_prompt: do not assume a cyber event is reportable; test the statutory reportable-situation elements
regimes.clock_prompt: verify 30-day period and knowledge or recklessness trigger
